findings: Stage 2 repair: the modeled presentation grounds only Taro and Ninereeds, but the first scored controlled prompts introduce Emma, Bob, and Errol inside the exercise stimulus (for example aff-02 through aff-04) without prior modeled identity/name grounding. Under the zero-convention baseline and the L000 participant-exemplar exception, rebuild the complete ordered presentation so every participant exemplar used by controlled practice is deliberately modeled before prediction, then return all dependent stages for revalidation.

Stage 12 repair: the lesson has no story-dependent comprehension test. da-01 explicitly measures direct learner self-application, while nc-01 and nc-02 replay the exact self-identification strings already modeled in presentation ("I'm Taro." and "I'm Ninereeds.") and ask for the portrait named by the utterance; both can be solved without attending to the page sequence, initial unknown-name state, development, or resolution. Replace them with closed, prerequisite-safe checks whose correct option depends on evidence unique to this story event, preserving executable demonstrations for any machine-only response convention.

Stage 9 repair: the displayed bindings for multiple negative and OR truth rows omit a named identity operand. neg-01 through neg-04 do not include the portrait/representation of Errol, Bob, Taro, or Emma respectively, and or-01 and or-03 omit Bob and Taro respectively, even though the presentation negative contrast includes both Taro and Ninereeds. Replan these exact exercise visuals so every asserted contrast/alternative is visibly grounded with all operands and enough context; independently pixel-review the actual displayed assets.

Stage 9 repair: four generated transformations/assets (scene-taro-bob, scene-emma-bob, scene-emma-errol, and scene-taro-errol) are referenced only by visual_plan/assets metadata and never by a learner-facing presentation, exercise, story turn, comprehension check, intervention, or replay. After the presentation repair, regenerate the visual plan and remove every still-unbound transformation; generation without a learner-facing teaching problem fails explicit visual necessity. Zero crops remains appropriate because no unresolved salience problem requires one.

Stage 13 repair: adaptive.maximum_teacher_turns is an unqualified global value of 4, although the frozen base path alone contains 14 modeled presentation turns, 20 controlled prompts, 20 mixed prompts, 8 story turns, 3 comprehension prompts, and 5 recap prompts. The lesson therefore cannot execute its required path under its declared budget. Define an executable scope and sufficient bound, add explicit terminal/success rules for each of the five controlled gates plus story, comprehension, and recap, and make FINISH eligibility reachable without undefined interpretation; keep PRESENT_AGAIN, TRAIN_MORE, TRAIN_LONGER, REPLAY_LESSON, and ALARM_FREEZE bounded as already enumerated.
